extracted.name: Caramel Crunch Apples
extracted.description: I recommend enjoying with vanilla ice cream.
ingredient_lines: 2 cans Fried Apples (15 ounce) Drain all but 1/4 cup of the apples liquid
8 Tablespoons Margarine. (Whole stick or 1/2 cup) Melted
instruction_lines: Spray baking pan (11inch by 7inch rectangular pan or 8inch square)
Add drained fried apples and reserved liquid to baking pan.
Mix melted margarine, nutmeg, cinnamon, oats, brown sugar, and flour together.
Pinch the crisp topping evenly over the apple caramel mixture.
Bake in oven for 40 minutes or until browned.
